title: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline Express Update on the adoption of physical exercise in patients with localised colon cancer
summary: Highlights • This ESMO CPG update addresses the adoption of physical exercise in patients with localised colon cancer. • Recommendations are given for the participation of eligible patients in structured exercise programmes. • An ESMO-MCBS score is provided to describe the level of evidence for physical exercise adoption. • An updated algorithm for the adjuvant treatment of localised stage II and stage III colon cancer is provided. • Recommendations are based on available scientific data and the authors’ collective expert opinion.
source_name: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline Express Update on the adoption of physical exercise in patients with localised colon cancer
